title: God Is Near to the Brokenhearted
opening: Scripture offers comfort to people who are grieving or exhausted. God’s care can be experienced through prayer, community, rest, and practical support.
points: Bring your sorrow honestly to God without shame.
Allow trustworthy people to listen and help you carry difficult seasons.
Offer gentle presence rather than quick explanations when others are hurting.
reflection: Where might you receive or offer compassionate support today?
prayer: God of comfort, draw near to those who are hurting. Give us patience, practical compassion, and hope for each new day. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
author: Daily Bible Teaching Team
